notes:
POC context: started with Hosted API to validate functionality and prompt quality. Now moving to Dedicated because product team needs predictable throughput for production feature (in-app assistant + weekly digest).

POC goals (customer language):
- 'We need consistent 5-10ms token latency for UI feel and predictable monthly compute costs.'
- Validate canary routing + graceful fallback to smaller/cheaper model if larger model degrades.
- Prove region failover (NA primary, EU backup) with no data leakage and KMS-managed keys.

Technical constraints / asks:
- Traffic profile: mix of short chat (median 150 tokens) + batch summarization jobs (up to 2k tokens). Peak concurrency target ~200 concurrent users -> 600-800 requests/min.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 210ms, p99 < 350ms for chat. Throughput target: sustained 200 req/s for embedding/rerank backfills (can be scheduled).
- Model preferences: start with FP16 Llama-style open model validated on Hosted; evaluate quantized 4-bit variant on Dedicated to save cost. Need auto-fallback to FP16 when quality drop detected.
- Routing: want policy-based smart routing: NA low-latency pool (primary), EU pool as failover; also ability to route by customer tier (premium -> low-latency nodes). Canary: start at 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% over 2 weeks if no regressions.
- Rollback criteria: increase in hallucination rate above 1.5x baseline on eval set OR 99th pct latency > target OR error rate > 0.5% over 1h. If triggered, auto-fallback to previous model variant + notify SE/AE.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) + SCIM. Audit logs required for all inference requests and admin changes (90+ day retention). Data residency: EU subset must not leave EU region; customer will require signed addendum. KMS key ownership preferred.

Commercial:
- Customer prefers term-based dedicated commitment (monthly) vs consumption. Initial ask: 3-month POC followed by 12-month pilot commit if POC meets targets. ARR target in discussion (50k-200k).

Quotes / direct from PM: 'We like the runtime approach but need a clear rollback story — outages are deal killers.'
